children: Some Bank of Japan policymakers called for speeding up the pace of interest rate hikes as underlying inflation reached the bank's 2% target, a summary of opinions at its October meeting showed on Tuesday.

"The effect of past rate hikes have yet to materialise and financial conditions remain accommodative. Japan is in a new phase where the BOJ needs to step up the pace of bringing its policy rate to neutral," one member was quoted as saying.
